title: Tart Jam Cookies
description: A sweet and tangy cookie recipe perfect for any time of day. This Italian-inspired treat combines the flavors of jam and tart.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and salt.
In a large bowl, use an electric mixer to beat butter and jam until smooth.
Beat in egg and vanilla extract.
Gradually add flour mixture to wet ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Scoop tablespoon-sized balls of dough onto prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until lightly golden.
Remove from oven and let cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
